role: AI exploratory post-outcome feasibility check of a standard singular-value perturbation bound on all old returned endpoints; not a new method, confirmation, physics study or student design
formula: beta_candidate(m)=max(0,beta_anchor-omega^2*||m-m_anchor||_infinity), since A(m)-A(anchor)=-omega^2*diag(m-anchor) and damping is model-independent
proof_scope: Exact-arithmetic triangle inequality for any unit vector, conditional on beta_anchor genuinely lower-bounding the least singular value. Stored anchor estimates use ordinary FP and unverified PSD allowance; this calculation cannot make them formal enclosures.
selection: All8 original witness anchors and all48 actual returned native-m models; 192 frequency/endpoint instances. No trajectories/PDE, outcome-based case filtering, refresh strategy or timing. All anchor-unavailable cases retained.
limits: Zero candidate bound means this simple sufficient condition is unavailable, not that the actual operator is unstable. Final endpoints cannot determine intermediate reuse duration, full-controller cost or recovery. Not an SCM comparison or novel general bound. All methods/cases are already inspected development inputs; no scientific confirmation or completed research requirement. No BP arrays or propagation are involved.
